scope: Three completed development branches, two new object pairs and two gains; not independent mechanisms or an LLM adoption study. Zero new source execution or API/model calls.
evidence: All attributions reconstruct archive-member identities from actual saved paid prefixes. No fitting, environment execution, or successor labels used to construct source knowledge.

interpretation.supported: Final source interval revision produced frozen knowledge that was actually selected and physically tested on new objects, with a paired improvement in one requested-point confirmation and aggregate compute reduction.
interpretation.positive_trace: adapted_law/objects_2/source_gain: C4=884 is confirmed at observation 38; all inherited members then fail. Ten new-source members support continuation; its selected C5=3237 is confirmed at observation 55 after a further online band revision. Before has no frozen survivor at that continuation and never confirms its requested C5 point.
interpretation.negative_trace: adapted_law/objects_2/shifted_gain: the new source selects C5=3237, but intervening paid responses refute both frozen and locally revised windows. The original question remains inconclusive and a later recall rejects the new archive; it is never counted as a confirmed request.
interpretation.remaining_core: Under the fixed 1% gain change, correct withdrawal is demonstrated but successor research increases by five actions and 11787 compute units including diagnostic exports. The next evidence gap is using those failed transfer observations to start productive revised research while preserving same-gain transfer, rather than further proving that source knowledge reaches the controller.

limitations: Twelve deterministic successor conditions of three related source branches; not independent mechanisms or LLM trials.
A confirmed requested physical point does not confirm every frozen interval; online band revision may remain necessary.
Source-gain and shifted-gain effects must remain separate; diagnostic exports and one-time source re-export are reported separately from charged execution.
